sub: A separate agent that had not seen this work re-measured every finding on both builds (Chromium, swiftshader, its own scripts), tested the edge sizes and looked for what was missed. Its verdicts are on each finding above; here is what it changed.
items: F1 confirmed, range corrected: on main the deck holds to 610px, so the row starts at 620 (scale 0.740, rows 9.6px) and stays under 12px up to about 765. The audit's 768 size passes by 0.1px (12.05). The comment at sections.css:75 («their text stays readable») is no longer true. Added to the finding: 667×375 (a small phone sideways) draws them at 10.9px.

F2 confirmed in Chromium, Safari unverified, and it found a second symptom (now part of F2): the open booking window's glass stops 15px short of the right edge at 1366×650. With ?fmbox=1 the fixed .page is 1185px wide at 1200 (1200 on Oct 19), with a lighter strip beside it.
F3 confirmed: 184px of text at 1440×900 (200 on Oct 19); all four descriptions now 3 lines of 14–18 characters (3/2/3/3 before).
F4 confirmed, widened: also 4 lines at 320; Oct 19 had 4 lines at every width checked, so main is better than round 4, but the decision still overstates.
F5 confirmed, corrected: deck.js's curves were already there on Oct 19 (reveal is new); missed: tokens.css copies the numbers of out and settle, which rules.mjs had exempted (now listed).
F6, F9 confirmed, not new (the same code on Oct 19). F9 reworded: the mail answers the question; the issue is the drawn order against the Tab order.
F7, F10, F12 confirmed. F10's fix: write 62em down as an own step; the copy of --phone in JS is unavoidable and says so.

F8 adjusted: only the feature padding is off the ladder; royalty ×1.6 and doc ×1.5 land on it; the CTA's +65px is the strip's height (structure, refuted). Missed and added: 404.css section-y × 2 = 160 at 1440, past the ladder's 128.
F11 mostly refuted as a tier: it is derived (half the label + the padding) so the closed card is a pill; now a note only.

rules.mjs: one-line rules were skipped (a declaration had to start a line), integer multipliers and GSAP ease names were missed, three spacing hits were structure. All fixed in this round's version; the run on this page is the fixed one.

New, from the review: F13 (the booking window's failure link is 21px tall), F14 (the cookie notice covers the hero button at 568×320, not new), F15 (after «Показать больше» the focused card can sit 17px below the screen).

No problem at: 568×320, 844×390, 1366×650, 2560×1440, 1024×768, the browser's text at 24px (390 and 1366), reduced motion: no sideways scroll, no console errors; the ring with ?fmring=gl drew with WebGL (139–171 draws), the 2D still once. Not checked: Safari, real classic scrollbars, Planerka's calendar itself, a real GPU, the Telegram cap in an app.
next: Decide F1: the ID cards' text at 9.6–12px between 620 and 765 wide and on small phones sideways. Options: the deck up to a ~47rem column (tablets upright then get the deck), or the row overlapping more before it scales; either way a 680×900 size in the audit.
In your Safari (F2): System Settings → Appearance → Show scroll bars: Always, then open the site: is there an empty strip at the right edge next to the scrollbar? And with the booking window open?
Questions: F3 (tile padding = radius, or padding capped at 24), F4 (three or four lines for the royalty titles), F9 (the footer's order on phones), F12 (the stack label as the heading).

Small fixes, one PR if you like: F5 (curves into the table, reveal → wave, CLAUDE.md's list), F6 (the cap through scroller.js or a recorded exception), F7 (two dead tokens), F8 (name the multiplied paddings), F10 (62em as an own step), F13 (a 24px target), F15 (scroll the revealed card into view).
Rules as a check: rules.mjs works on the whole repo now (16 rules, 2 hard ones broken). Say if it should become npm run rules in CI next to the audit (round 3 and round 4 asked the same).
Figma: not opened this round, as you asked. Next: compare the variables with tokens.json (radius/s 32, type/hero 60, section/air-l are code-side changes since the last push).

From round 4, still open: on your iPhone, sideways in Safari, the navbar while scrolling past the hero; short laptops (the hero past the fold at 1366×650: 673px against 650). The pinned-pill questions are gone with the pill.

findings.what: ID cards: text drawn at 9.6–12px between 620 and 765px wide, and on small phones sideways
findings.evidence: The row is scaled by min(1, column / 757) from a 35rem column, so from 620 to 765 it is at 0.74–0.92 and the 13px rows are drawn at 9.6–12px, the names at 18–22 (sweep every 10px). 667×375 (iPhone SE sideways): 10.9px. iPad split view (639, 678, 694 wide) falls in the range. Not new: round 4 drew the same. The audit's 768 passes by 0.1px and no audit size lands in the range; sections.css:75 says «their text stays readable».
findings.fix: Move the deck up to a ~47rem column, or let the row overlap more before it scales; add a 680×900 size to the audit; correct the comment.

findings.verdict: confirmed in Chromium; a second symptom found
findings.what: The stable scrollbar gutter takes 15px from fixed layers
findings.evidence: book.css:63 (Oct 19) html { scrollbar-gutter: stable }. In Chromium it takes 15px off fixed boxes: the open booking window's glass stops 15px short of the right edge (1366×650), and in the box mode (?fmbox=1) .page is 1185 wide at 1200 with a strip beside it. By the spec the gutter is kept even with html overflow hidden, so Safari on a Mac with classic scrollbars (a mouse plugged in, or «Show scroll bars: Always») would show that strip next to .page's own scrollbar. Safari not available here.
findings.fix: html:not(.boxed) { scrollbar-gutter: stable }, the gutter on html.boxed .page instead, and the window's glass inset 0 on the viewport (or right: calc(100vw - 100%) undone). Check in your Safari.

findings.what: The booking window's way out is a 21px target
findings.evidence: When the calendar does not load («Календарь не загрузился»), the only way on, «Открыть запись на сайте Планёрки», is 278×21px on a 390 phone, under WCAG 2.5.8's 24px. The audit never opens the window, so it never sees it.
findings.fix: padding-block on the link (a 24px+ line), and an audit step that opens the window in its failed state.

findings.verdict: new, from the review; not new on the site
findings.what: The cookie notice covers the hero's button on a small phone sideways
findings.evidence: 568×320 (touch): the notice (8–284 × 248–312) covers 101×18px of «Запланировать демо» (183–385 × 230–266) until «ОК». The same on Oct 19; 667×375 and 844×390 are clear.
findings.fix: Under --sideways, put the notice at the right edge (the button is centred), or give the hero's text room for it.

findings.what: Tiles and half-column cards drift together; the feature texts got narrower
findings.evidence: radius/s 16 → 32 (Oct 22) against radius/m 24 → 40: ×0.67 apart on a phone, ×0.8 on a computer (×0.6 before). A tile's padding is its radius, so the feature text column went 200 → 184px at 1440×900: all four descriptions run 3 lines of 14–18 characters (3/2/3/3 before); on a 390 phone up to 5 lines of about 12.
findings.fix: A question: keep padding = radius on tiles (concentric corners), or cap the tiles' padding at 24 while the radius grows to 32.

findings.what: Royalty titles take four lines at 320 and between 640 and 880px
findings.evidence: 3 lines at 390–600 and from 920 up; 4 lines of about 16 characters at 640–880 (the card beside its drawing at 620–730, two cards a row from 740) and at 320. decisions.json#royalty-by-shape says three lines. Round 4 had 4 lines at every width, so this is better than it was.
findings.fix: Write «three, four in a narrow card» in the decision, or let the title beside the drawing take more of the card (0.55 instead of 0.5).

findings.what: Curves outside the one table, and one curve with two names
findings.evidence: deck.js: power2.in / power2.inOut / power1.out for the swipe (already on Oct 19); cookies.js: its own cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), a near-copy of move (0.25); book.css: ease-in-out for the loader dots; tokens.css copies the numbers of out and settle (CSS cannot import them: a written exception would say so). M.curve.reveal = M.curve.wave (0.5, 0, 0.5, 1), new on Oct 23. CLAUDE.md lists 7 curves; the table has 8.
findings.fix: Name the swipe and the drawn line in M.curve (or use move / out), reveal → wave, list the table in CLAUDE.md, and note in tokens.css that its two curves mirror M.curve.

findings.what: The Telegram cap reads the window's scroll directly
findings.evidence: nav.js initCap listens to window «scroll» and reads scrollY (lines 79–109), which CLAUDE.md forbids. Deliberate (it returns in the box mode and runs only in apps' browsers) but not recorded: telegram-cap-flicker names initCap, not this. Its colour is a literal #fff.
findings.fix: scroller.onScroll and y() (the same there), or the exception in decisions.json; var(--paper) for the colour.

findings.evidence: --ink-40 (tokens.json still says «Footer notes»; the footer uses ink 50 since Oct 18) and --purple-light (the CTA's light purple until Oct 19) are written to tokens.gen.css and read by nothing in the styles, the HTML or the scripts. Both still sync to Figma.
findings.fix: Remove both (and from Figma at the next push), or re-describe them if Figma still uses them.

findings.what: Two sizes off the ladder through a factor
findings.evidence: The features' bottom padding radius/s × 1.33 (21.3 → 42.6) and the 404 page's section/pad-y × 2 (80 → 160, past the ladder's 128). Other factors land on the ladder (royalty × 1.6 = 64 → 128, legal pages × 1.5 = 60 → 120) but are roles nobody named, as the CTA's × 1.4 was until section/air-l.
findings.fix: feature/pad-bottom 20 → 44 and a 404 role in scale.json, so the build checks them.

findings.what: After «Показать больше» the focused card can be off-screen
findings.evidence: With 5 publications the button shows one more card and moves the focus to it with preventScroll: at 1366×650 the card ends at 667 against a 650 screen, 17px below it.
findings.fix: Scroll it into view (block: nearest) once it has come in, or focus without preventScroll.

findings.what: Footer on phones: drawn order and Tab order differ
findings.evidence: footer.css .footer__row: column-reverse below 768, so «Запланировать демо» is drawn above the question and the mail, while a screen reader and Tab go question → mail → button (WCAG 1.3.2 / 2.4.3, low impact).
findings.fix: A question: if the button should come first, put it first in the HTML (row-reverse on computers).

findings.evidence: book.css and book.js switch the booking window at 62em (992px: Planerka's three columns); media.css and CLAUDE.md know two page steps.
findings.fix: Write 62em down as an own step (third party) in media.css and CLAUDE.md.

findings.what: The stack's label is the heading, its titles are subheadings
findings.evidence: .card__tag is an h2 at 14–18px; the stack titles (26–52px) are h3 under it, so a screen reader's list of headings shows «Управление» as the section.
findings.fix: Fine as an outline; if the titles should lead, the label a p and the titles h2.

findings.what: The stack card's radius is derived, not on the ladder
findings.evidence: --card-r = half the label + the padding: 42.4 → 64 (1440×900), above radius/l's 56, so a closed card is a perfect pill. Written in stack.css, not in scale.json.
findings.fix: Nothing to change; the grammar on this page names it.
